source: 16. When can multi-query retrieval and rank fusion help, and why is generating more query variants not automatically better? [Advanced] A single phrasing can miss relevant material, so a system may generate several query variants, retrieve for each, take a union, and fuse the rankings. Reciprocal Rank Fusion is useful here because it combines rank positions without requiring raw scores from different result lists to be calibrated. Multi-query retrieval can broaden recall when variants capture genuinely different vocabulary or facets. It can also increase latency, duplicate candidates, and amplify a bad rewrite across several searches. More variants therefore do not monotonically improve quality. Preserve the original query, deduplicate results, cap the expansion budget, and measure marginal recall from each added query. If the corpus is dominated by exact identifiers or the original query is already specific, extra variants may add mostly noise. The underlying principles - query expansion plus rank fusion - are more durable than any particular ’ZXNAME0000XZ-Fusion’ recipe. [9][11]
zh: 16. 多查询检索和排名融合何时可以提供帮助？为什么生成更多查询变体不会自动更好？ [高级] 单个短语可能会错过相关材料，因此系统可能会生成多个查询变体，对每个变体进行检索，采用并集并融合排名。倒数排名融合在这里很有用，因为它结合了排名位置，而不需要校准来自不同结果列表的原始分数。当变体捕获真正不同的词汇或方面时，多查询检索可以扩大召回范围。它还会增加延迟、重复候选者，并在多个搜索中放大错误的重写。因此，更多的变体并不能单调地提高质量。保留原始查询，删除重复结果，限制扩展预算，并测量每个添加查询的边际召回率。如果语料库以精确标识符为主，或者原始查询已经是特定的，则额外的变体可能会增加大部分噪音。基本原则 - 查询扩展加上排名融合 - 比任何特定的“ZXNAME0000XZ-Fusion”配方更持久。 [9][11]
